== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Nakothi]]'s [[Children]] are monstrous entities created from human remains through the influence of [[Nakothi]], a [[Great Elder]] who governed the domains of death and birth. These creatures are formed when [[Nakothi]]'s power embeds itself into corpses, a process she used to transform humans into specialized workers or ambassadors. While [[Nakothi]] may view this as an improvement of the human form, the resulting beings are often grotesque, appearing as desiccated husks, mismatched piles of organs, or various deformed shapes such as white mantises. They are characterized by a mindless bloodlust and an insatiable [[hunger]], often accompanied by the stench of decay. The [[Children]] are highly varied in appearance and can be found swarming islands, crawling through forests like underbrush, or lurking in arenas. They are frequently guided and called to battle by a figure known as the [[Handmaiden]]. Although they possess simple and focused minds rather than deep intelligence, they can be driven by specific purposes or commands. While they are formidable enough to overwhelm many, they can be combated by those with invested weapons.}}
